tier.note: Label instructs to discontinue when pregnancy is recognized because cholesterol synthesis inhibition may cause fetal harm, and hyperlipidemia treatment is generally unnecessary during pregnancy.

refs.quote: Discontinue LIPITOR when pregnancy is recognized. Alternatively, consider the ongoing therapeutic needs of the individual patient. LIPITOR decreases synthesis of cholesterol and possibly other biologically active substances derived from cholesterol; therefore, LIPITOR may cause fetal harm when administered to pregnant patients based on the mechanism of action
